mapper.sql: id, enabled, source_name, source_type, original_url, copyright_status, review_status, copyright_note, reviewed_by, review_comment, reviewed_at, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM exam_question_source WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE exam_question_source SET source_name = #{sourceName}, source_type = #{sourceType}, original_url = #{originalUrl}, copyright_status = #{copyrightStatus}, copyright_note = #{copyrightNote}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND review_status IN ('DRAFT', 'PENDING', 'REJECTED') AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM exam_question q JOIN exam_paper_item_snapshot snapshot ON snapshot.original_question_id=q.id WHERE q.source_id=#{id} )

UPDATE exam_question_source SET copyright_status = #{copyrightStatus}, review_status = 'APPROVED', reviewed_by = #{reviewedBy}, reviewed_at = #{reviewedAt}, review_comment = #{reviewComment}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND #{copyrightStatus} IN ('ORIGINAL', 'AUTHORIZED', 'PUBLIC_OFFICIAL')

UPDATE exam_question_source SET copyright_status = #{copyrightStatus}, review_status = 'REJECTED', reviewed_by = #{reviewedBy}, reviewed_at = #{reviewedAt}, review_comment = #{reviewComment}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{id}
